proof_0361.moves: Membership in lifts means exhibiting a polynomial that maps to X; the witness is X itself, and the verification is the standard fact that map sends X to X. So: supply the witness, then close with map_X (the rest is simp-generated equality plumbing).

proof_0362.moves: A simp/API lemma computing the inverse of the smulConst homeomorphism on a point. The inverse is definitionally the given formula, so the proof is pure definitional unfolding closed by rfl -- no mathematical step at all.

proof_0363.moves: Connected = Preconnected + Nonempty. From edge-connectedness one already has preconnectedness (a named lemma), and the vertex type is nonempty (packaged in the edge-connectivity hypothesis with k not zero); assemble the two into the Connected structure.

proof_0364.moves: A projection/simp lemma for the inverse of the algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over a unique index type and univariate polynomials. The equivalence is built so this holds definitionally; the proof is rfl. No mathematical content beyond unfolding the definition.

proof_0365.moves: Specialize the existing construction of a module structure from an additive-torsion hypothesis, obtaining that hypothesis from finiteness via the finite-implies-torsion lemma. Two lemma applications composed.

proof_0366.moves: A Raw-layer wrapper: unfold the raw tree map to its internal Impl representation, convert the WF hypothesis into the internal well-formedness predicate, and invoke the already-proved Impl lemma. The content is the transfer, not new mathematics.

proof_0367.moves: Same wrapper pattern: peel the Raw structure down to its inner Impl, feed the well-formedness proof through WF.out, and apply the corresponding Impl-level getD/modify lemma verbatim.

proof_0368.moves: A hash set is a hash map with unit values, so the size-after-bulk-insert statement is exactly the corresponding hash map lemma about insertManyIfNewUnit; unwrap the set to its inner map and apply it. The pairwise-distinctness hypothesis is what makes the size formula true.

proof_0369.moves: Uniform summability on a family of sets is by definition uniform convergence of the net of partial sums; transport along that characterization, apply monotonicity of uniform convergence under shrinking the set, and transport back.

proof_0370.moves: The real-to-EReal coercion and the toReal projection are definitional inverses on the image of the coercion, so the statement holds by rfl. Pure unfolding.

proof_0371.moves: If one graph is a subgraph of another, the induced map on connected components (from the inclusion homomorphism) is surjective, so the target has no more components than the source; conclude by the cardinality bound for surjections between finite types.

proof_0372.moves: The product of two closed sets in the Closeds lattice is defined by taking the product of the underlying sets, so the coercion lemma is true by definition; the proof is rfl and the real content is the definition of the SProd instance.

proof_0373.moves: Specialize the more general result (continuity on a set contained in a compact set gives a.e. strong measurability) by taking the compact set to be the set itself, i.e. instantiate the subset hypothesis with reflexivity of inclusion.

proof_0374.moves: Multiplication is the scalar action of a monoid on itself, so the product of a locally uniformly convergent family with a continuous bounded factor is just the scalar-multiplication version of the theorem applied through the Mul-to-SMul instance.

proof_0375.moves: Use the congruence lemma for a.e. equality of intersections: intersect the hypothesis (s a.e. equals univ) with the reflexive a.e. equality of t, then rewrite univ-intersect-t to t. Mostly a rewrite chain around one congruence lemma.

proof_0376.moves: Being an integral curve everywhere trivially restricts to being one on a subset: fix a point of the set and weaken the (global) derivative statement at that point to a within-the-set derivative statement. The only real step is HasDerivAt to HasDerivWithinAt.

proof_0377.moves: Rewrite the union over a countable collection of sets as an indexed union over the collection itself, then apply the already-proved congruence lemma for restrictions to a countable indexed union.

proof_0378.moves: Membership in the orthogonal complement of the underlying submodule of a closed submodule is by definition membership in the orthogonal complement; the proof is Iff.rfl. Pure definitional unfolding through the toSubmodule coercion.

proof_0379.moves: The arithmetic-geometric mean dominates the minimum of its two arguments, and the minimum of two positive numbers is positive; chain the strict inequality 0 < min with the non-strict min <= agm.

proof_0380.moves: There is an iff characterizing when separable degree is additive on a product (a disjunction of side conditions); coprimality supplies the right disjunct, so the proof is: pick the correct branch of the disjunction and feed it to the mpr direction of the characterization.

proof_0381.moves: The companion lemma says the ball of radius infDist to the complement is contained in the complement of the complement; cancel the double complement to land in the set itself. One inclusion plus one rewrite.

proof_0382.moves: The cells of a subcomplex in each dimension form a subtype of the cells of the ambient complex; since the ambient complex has finitely many cells in each dimension, so does the subtype. Build the FiniteType structure from finiteness of a subtype of a finite type.

proof_0383.moves: Cancellation on the left follows from cancellation on the right by commuting the sums: rewrite both sides with commutativity of measure addition and apply the right-cancellation lemma.

proof_0384.moves: The norm is continuous, i.e. it tends to the norm of the limit point; compose that with the given convergence of the function to get convergence of the norms. Composition of a tendsto with continuity of the norm map.
